publicProductReceiptScope: Exact product bytes and alias layout; published Git entry is independently checked by the workflow.
processObservationScope: Prior completed controller observation; current role and case byte identity is explicit in controller-platform-identity.json.
hostedCIResultAuthority: GitHub Actions run and artifacts for the exact PR/main revision; artifact qualification is not a workflow completion claim.
correctnessScope: Each retained receipt names its exact producer. Additional complete27 all19/MIR/GMIR/resource results are recorded with the PR and workflow qualification, without editing prior receipts.
